# CareBridge MF-01–MF-10 Postman Test Guide

> Status: Planning documentation. No row in this guide is an execution result. Test date, tester, evidence, Pass and Fail remain blank/pending until a real run is completed.

## Environment and startup

Use a disposable PostgreSQL environment or a user-confirmed Supabase test project only. The configured Supabase hostname did not contain an explicit `test`, `qa`, `dev`, or `staging` marker, so this generator did not connect to it or mutate it.

```powershell
# Backend (Windows)
Set-Location 05_Development/CareBridgeAPI
.\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

# Web
Set-Location 05_Development/CareBridgeWebApp
npm run dev

# AI triage
Set-Location 05_Development/CareBridgeAITriageService
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001

# Mobile
Set-Location 05_Development/CareBridgeMobileApp
flutter run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://10.0.2.2:8080
```

Base URL for direct local API debugging: `http://localhost:8080`. Web dev origin: `http://localhost:5173`. Android emulator host alias: `http://10.0.2.2:8080`.

## Supabase/test accounts

| Test Account | Role | Purpose | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| admin@carebridge.dev | SYSTEM_ADMIN (ADMIN coverage) | Admin/RBAC/Audit | Conditional DevDataSeeder/README; live Supabase existence not verified |
| mother@carebridge.dev | MOTHER | Mother/private data | Conditional DevDataSeeder/README; live Supabase existence not verified |
| family@carebridge.dev | FAMILY | Family permission/sync | Conditional DevDataSeeder/README; live Supabase existence not verified |
| expert@carebridge.dev | EXPERT | Expert/trust/contribution | Conditional DevDataSeeder/README; live Supabase existence not verified |

The accounts above are source-backed conditional seed definitions, not proof that they currently exist in the connected Supabase project. Set each Postman account variable only after confirming the row in the authorized test database. Never place a password in this file or Google Sheets.

## Mock data namespace

Use `qa_admin_01`, `qa_mother_01`, `qa_family_01`, `qa_expert_01`, `qa_consent_01`, `qa_care_group_01`, `qa_article_01`, `qa_checklist_01`, `qa_question_01`, `qa_answer_01`, `qa_baby_01`, and `qa_mother_journey_01`. Prefer existing `DevDataSeeder` fixtures such as `mother3/4/5/6`, `family2/3`, and `expert2/3` after verifying they exist in the selected test database.

## Execution order

1. Confirm the target is a disposable/test database and verify the four required seed accounts.
2. Configure environment variables without printing secrets.
3. Start dependencies and services using the commands above.
4. Execute MF-01 Login for all four required roles; store tokens only in Postman environment variables.
5. Execute MF-01 through MF-10 in order. Capture real request/response, UI, database, audit and provider evidence.
6. Enter the actual execution date/tester/status into the Sheet only after evidence exists.

## Request-by-request instructions

# MF01 — Account, Trust & Access Control

## MF01-ACTION-001 — Verify that the Login button cannot be submitted repeatedly while sign-in is in progress.

1. Purpose

Verify that the Login button cannot be submitted repeatedly while sign-in is in progress.

2. Source and Requirement Mapping

- Requirement: UC-02–UC-18
- Source: `05_Development/CareBridgeAPI/src/main/java/com/carebridge/backend/security/controller/AuthController.java`
- Request DTO: `05_Development/CareBridgeAPI/src/main/java/com/carebridge/backend/security/dto/request/LoginRequest.java`

3. Test Account and Mock Data

Use only verified synthetic accounts and `mf01_qa_*` fixtures. Authorization policy: `Public`.

4. Pre-condition

A valid active Mother mock account is available.
The user is currently on the Login page.

5. HTTP Method

```text
POST
```

6. URL

```text
{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/auth/login
```

Open Postman, select the method from the dropdown, and paste the URL next to Send. For UI/device-only cases, follow the Test Case Procedure instead.

7. Headers

```text
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
```

Open Headers and enter each key/value. Do not add Authorization for a public endpoint. Use the token for the role under test and never capture a full token in evidence.

8. Query Parameters

```text
None
```

9. Path Parameters

```text
None
```

10. Body

Open Body → raw → JSON, then paste the source-derived body below. Do not add fields that are absent from the DTO.

```json
{
  "email": "{{motherEmail}}",
  "password": "{{testPassword}}"
}
```

11. Send Request

1. Review the selected Postman environment.
2. Click Send once.
3. Wait for the request to finish.
4. Record the actual HTTP status and response body.
5. Do not copy secrets into evidence.

12. Expected Response

Expected HTTP status: `200`. Validate the implemented response contract, authorization scope, and error envelope against the source handler and DTO.

13. Supabase Verification

Tables: `users, auth_sessions, otp_verifications, privacy_settings, consent_grants, notification_preferences, audit_events`. Filter by the dynamic owner/resource IDs used in the request. Verify only the create/update/delete/revoke/read effect stated in Expected Results; do not alter unrelated data.

14. External Integration Verification

SMTP/SMS OTP test adapter

15. Evidence Screenshot

Capture method, URL, non-secret headers, body, response status/body, relevant Supabase row, UI result, audit row, and provider/test-mailbox result when applicable. Redact tokens, passwords, private keys and identifiable health data.

16. Evidence Filename

```text

MF01-ACTION-001-supabase.png

```
